sentence: This project studies how lipids in a biological membrane affect the proteins embedded in it.
This project studies how different types of brain cells interact in Alzheimer's Disease, using computer models and 3D Alzheimer's-in-a-dish models.
This project studies how physical activity, infection, biological sex and genotype relate to dementia and brain atrophy in two groups of Native Americans.
This project builds a 3D MRI method that maps oxygen metabolism in the brain in dementia.
This project studies how deltaretroviruses, which are linked to lymphoid leukemias, assemble their particles.
This project studies what a long non-coding RNA does in the start and growth of the brain tumor glioblastoma.
This project tries to find out what sets and changes the diversity of presynaptic function at glutamatergic synapses.
This project studies why some children get herpes simplex encephalitis, using forebrain and hindbrain neurons and organoids made from patient-specific cells.
This project tries to find out how a ketogenic diet causes hypercholesterolemia in susceptible adults.
This project tests combined treatments for alcohol use disorder and alcohol-associated liver disease in patients with advanced liver disease.
This project studies why head and neck cancer and pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma respond differently to radiation immunotherapy, focusing on regulatory T cells.
This project builds HIV vaccine designs using virus-like particles and a fusion peptide to raise antibodies that neutralize the virus.
This project studies how a neuropeptide affects inflammation after traumatic brain injury and whether it can improve cognitive outcome.
This project provides shared resources and technical expertise for vision research on ocular diseases.
This project studies how cells in the ventral hippocampus that carry dopamine receptor type 2 affect relapse in cocaine use disorder.
This project builds predictive models that use health-related social needs data to improve outcomes for out-of-hospital cardiac arrest patients.
This project builds a culture platform that helps muscle stem cells maintain and expand by directing their polarity, division and fate.
This project studies how genes and folic acid exposure relate to human meningomyelocele.
This project tests a chemiluminescence probe that images amyloid beta in mice to track how well Alzheimer's disease drugs work.
